reviews.text: Absolutely the best noise cancelling headphones I have ever used. The ANC is phenomenal and the sound quality is top notch. Battery lasts all day easily.
Great sound quality, very comfortable for long hours. Worth every penny for an audiophile. Battery life is impressive.
Good headphones but the hinge feels fragile. Sound quality is excellent though.
Had connectivity issues with my laptop. Keeps dropping the Bluetooth connection every few minutes. Very frustrating experience.
Perfect for long flights. The noise cancellation blocks out everything. Super comfortable even after 8 hours of continuous use.
Best headphones in this price range. Call quality is also very clear and crisp. Noise cancellation is outstanding.
Sound quality is crisp and clear. Noise cancellation works brilliantly in office environments and busy cafes.
Very disappointed. Ear cups started peeling after 3 months. Poor build quality for such expensive headphones.
Sound is good but not worth the price for a casual listener. There are cheaper options available.
Excellent noise cancellation and battery life. Blocks out all traffic noise during daily commute perfectly.
XM5 blew me away. Coming from Bose QC45, the active noise cancellation is on another level. Sound quality is outstanding.
Great headphones overall. No IP rating so cannot use during workouts. For daily commute it is absolutely perfect.
The companion app is buggy on Android. Keeps crashing and resetting EQ settings. Bluetooth connectivity drops sometimes.
Battery life is incredible. Noise cancellation is the best I have ever tested on any headphones.
Sound is amazing but Bluetooth multipoint connectivity can be finicky when switching between devices.
Top pick for premium headphones. Unmatched noise cancellation, 30-hour battery life, and lush sound quality make this the go-to for professionals and travelers.
Premium experience for a premium price. Sound quality is absolutely excellent. Hinge build quality could be better.
After testing over 50 headphones this year, the XM5 remains our editor choice. Active noise cancellation technology is simply unmatched.
Best Android phone I have ever used. Camera quality is incredible especially in low light photography. Battery life lasts a full day.
Great performance, smooth display and fast charging. AI features are actually useful unlike gimmicks on other phones.
Good phone but gets warm under load. Gaming for 30 minutes and it is noticeably hot to touch.
Camera is oversharpened. Photos look artificial and heavily processed. Low light performance is disappointing.
Display quality is stunning. The 120Hz refresh rate makes everything smooth. Camera system is versatile and powerful.
Flagship experience at its finest. One UI is smooth and blazing fast. Love the premium titanium frame build quality.
Very good all-rounder. Circle to Search feature is genuinely useful. Build quality feels extremely premium.
Heating issue is very real. Cannot play games for more than 20 minutes without the phone becoming uncomfortably hot.
Decent phone but Samsung bloatware is very annoying. Too many pre-installed apps that cannot be removed.
Camera zoom capabilities are outstanding. Night mode photography produces stunning results. Fast charging is excellent.
Camera zoom capabilities are insane. Travel photography is a completely upgraded experience now with this phone.
Great phone overall but Samsung bloatware is very annoying to deal with. Many pre-installed apps serve no purpose.
Camera quality especially in low light is genuinely impressive and competitive with much more expensive phones.
Thermal throttling is a real problem during extended gaming. The processor slows down significantly to manage heat.
Samsung Galaxy S24 delivers on almost every front. AI features set it apart but heating under sustained load remains a notable concern.
Best Samsung phone in years. Improved camera system, cleaner software, and excellent display quality. Our top Android recommendation.
Changed my life completely. I cook meals in 20 minutes that used to take 2 hours. Pressure cooking is a game changer for busy families.
Best kitchen appliance ever. Easy to clean, multiple cooking functions, and very reliable. Using it almost every day.
Great product overall. Slight learning curve at first but cooking becomes incredibly fast and convenient once you understand it.
Decent but the rubber seal starts to smell after a few months. Need to clean it thoroughly to avoid odour between dishes.
Lid locking mechanism broke after 6 months of regular use. Customer service was very slow to respond to my complaint.
Perfect for meal prep. Cook large batches on Sunday and have food ready for the entire week. Slow cook function is excellent too.
Must have for Indian cooking. Dal, biryani, and curries come out perfect every time. Saves so much time and gas.
Very good multi-cooker. Build quality is solid and the inner pot is easy to clean. Worth every rupee spent.
Good but takes up a lot of counter space. If you have a small kitchen you need to plan carefully where to keep it.
Excellent product. Pressure cooking cuts cooking time dramatically. Made rajma in 25 minutes. Outstanding performance.
Solid appliance with great versatility. The saute function is underrated. Full replacement for both a pot and slow cooker.
Good cooker but the learning curve is steeper than advertised. Took several weeks to understand all the pressure settings.
Life changing kitchen tool. Chicken stock that used to take 8 hours now takes 90 minutes with incredible flavour.
Instant Pot Duo remains our top pick for home pressure cookers. Versatile, durable, and genuinely time-saving for busy home cooks.
Essential kitchen appliance for modern households. The 7-in-1 functionality genuinely replaces multiple appliances.
Incredible noise cancellation for such small earbuds. Sound quality is detailed and rich. Battery life with the case lasts me an entire week.
Best earbuds I have ever owned. Transparency mode sounds completely natural. Comfortable fit for hours of continuous listening.
Great sound quality but very expensive. The fit does not work perfectly for everyone. Ears get tired after 2 hours of wearing.
One earbud stopped working after just 4 months. Having to replace them so quickly is unacceptable at this premium price point.
Adaptive audio feature is brilliant. Seamless integration with iPhone and Mac is unmatched by any competitor in the market.
Outstanding earbuds with premium build quality. Compact case charges wirelessly. Noise cancellation blocks out everything.
Excellent sound quality and comfortable fit. Touch controls are intuitive and responsive. Battery life is good for daily commuting.
Way too expensive for the battery life you get. Only 6 hours per charge is disappointing compared to competitors.
Coming from original AirPods Pro the upgrade is massive. Noise cancellation improvement is dramatic. Worth the premium price.
Excellent earbuds but truly great only if you are in the Apple ecosystem. iPhone and Mac integration is seamless.
Sound quality is very good but fit is hit or miss. The ear tips included do not work perfectly for everyone.
AirPods Pro 2 set the standard for premium wireless earbuds. Best-in-class noise cancellation and seamless Apple integration make them the obvious choice for iPhone users.
Excellent value for money smartphone. Performance is smooth for daily tasks and the camera produces sharp detailed photos in good lighting.
Best budget phone in this price segment. Fast charging is incredibly quick and battery lasts comfortably through a full day of heavy usage.
Good phone for the price but camera performance in low light is quite disappointing and produces noisy grainy images.
Heating issues during gaming sessions. Phone gets uncomfortably warm after just 20 minutes of playing demanding games.
Outstanding value smartphone. Smooth performance, excellent fast charging, and clean OxygenOS software. Highly recommended for budget buyers.
Great mid-range phone with premium feel. Display is bright and vibrant. Battery life with 80W fast charging is a major advantage.
Decent phone overall but software updates have been slow and inconsistent. OnePlus needs to improve long-term software support.
Solid budget option that punches well above its price. Fast charging from zero to full in under 30 minutes is genuinely impressive.
Camera quality is inconsistent. Great shots in daylight but terrible low light performance makes it unsuitable for evening photography.
OnePlus Nord CE 3 delivers impressive performance for its competitive price. The 80W fast charging and smooth display make it one of the best value propositions in the mid-range segment.
Most stunning picture quality I have ever seen on any television. The blacks are absolutely perfect and colors are incredibly vibrant. Gaming performance with low input lag is outstanding.
Worth every penny. OLED display makes streaming content look cinematic. HDR content looks absolutely breathtaking on this panel.
Excellent TV with stunning picture quality. Only concern is potential burn-in risk with static content over long time.
Picture quality is amazing but the built-in speakers are quite disappointing and weak. You will definitely need a soundbar.
Best television I have ever owned. Picture quality during night scenes with deep blacks is absolutely unreal and stunning.
Outstanding display quality for both movies and gaming. WebOS interface is smooth and responsive. Remote control is sleek.
Burn-in appeared on my unit after 8 months of normal use. This is a serious concern for the asking price of this television.
Gaming on this TV is a transformative experience. The 120Hz panel with 1ms response time and VRR support makes every game look incredible.
Gorgeous picture quality that you cannot find in any LED TV. The perfect blacks make night scenes look completely cinematic.
Great TV but burn-in risk is real and worth considering if you watch news or sports channels with static logos.
LG C3 OLED is our unanimous pick for the best TV of the year. Unrivaled picture quality, excellent gaming features, and refined smart TV platform make it worth every penny.
